headline: Anthropic Plans to Sell $3.5 Billion in Shares to Japanese Investors
summary: Artificial intelligence startup Anthropic plans to sell $3.5 billion worth of shares to Japanese investors ahead of an IPO, according to a filing.
why: Anthropic is a prominent artificial intelligence company competing in foundational model development. Large capital raises signal intense funding competition and valuation trends in the AI sector.

impacts.why: Planning a $3.5 billion share sale to investors.
